data.name: Ghamir
data.gender_notes: Ghamir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The one who covers, conceals, or envelops
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, Ghamir is mentioned in various hadiths and narrations, where it refers to Allah's mercy and forgiveness towards His creation. The name symbolizes the concept of protection, shelter, and blessings bestowed upon believers. The name Ghamir carries the meaning “The one who covers, conceals, or envelops” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghamir usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who covers, conceals, or envelops and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's infinite mercy and protection.
data.etymology: Ghamir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The one who covers, conceals, or envelops.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghamir total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: غامر
in_arabic.meaning: غامر يعني الغامض أو العميق في المعنى أو الغني بالمعاني
in_arabic.long_meaning: غامر هو اسم مشتق من الجذر غ-م-ر، ويعني الغامض أو العميق في المعنى، أو الغني بالمعاني. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُولَٰئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْئُولًا' (الإسراء: 36)، حيث يشير إلى العمق في المعنى والغموض في التعبير.

in_urdu.name: غامر
in_urdu.meaning: غامر مطلب ہے گہرا یا مالا مال معنیوں والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: غامر ایک نام ہے جو عربی جڑ غ-م-ر سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے گہرا یا مالا مال معنیوں والا۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں۔ اس کا استعمال تاریخی طور پر اسلامی ثقافت میں گہری معنی اور بھرپور مضامین کے حامل نام کے طور پر کیا جاتا رہا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ग़ामिर
in_hindi.meaning: ग़ामिर का अर्थ है गहरा या समृद्ध अर्थों वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: ग़ामिर एक नाम है जो अरबी मूल غ-م-र से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है गहरा या समृद्ध अर्थों वाला। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है, खासकर भारत में। इसका उपयोग ऐतिहासिक रूप से इस्लामी संस्कृति में गहरे अर्थ और समृद्ध विषयों वाले नाम के रूप में किया जाता रहा है।

in_pashto.name: غامر
in_pashto.meaning: غامر د لوی یا مالا مال معنا لرونکی معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: غامر د عربي کلمې غ-م-ر نه اخستل شوی دی، چي معنی يې د لوی يا مالا مال معنا لرونکی دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو نومونو څخه دی، چي د تاريخي پلوه د پښتنو په کلتور کې د معنوي او مذهبي ارزښتونو د لرونکي نوم په توګه کارول شوی دی.

in_english.name: Ghamir
in_english.meaning: Ghamir means profound or rich in meanings
in_english.long_meaning: Ghamir is a name derived from the Arabic root غ-م-ر (ghamara), which means to be deep or rich in meanings. It is associated with depth, richness, and complexity. In Islamic tradition, names like Ghamir are chosen for their spiritual significance and positive connotations. The name reflects qualities of wisdom, insight, and intellectual depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ghamir" holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic world. It is the name of the 114th chapter in the Holy Quran, and its title means "The Persistent", "The Relenting" or "The Overwhelming". The name suggests the continuous nature of Allah's mercy towards His creation, reminding Muslims of His boundless grace and forgiveness.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Ghamir" has deep meaning for Muslims. It serves as a reminder of Allah's infinite mercy and forgiveness. It echoes the idea that regardless of one's past actions, Allah is always ready to forgive and grant mercy to those who repent and strive towards a better future. The name is a source of comfort and optimism, offering the reassurance that even in the face of transgressions, Allah's mercy and forgiveness can overcome them. This spiritual significance founding hope, optimism, and a deep sense of gratitude and dependence on Allah.
